# ANEMONE fixtures

`sample_listing.html` and `run_listing.html` are synthetic acquisition fixtures.

`community_qc3nn_target.tsv` is the unchanged, user-approved ANEMONE reference
received on 2026-09-11. Its SHA-256 is
`e9923f5b0251ec30d61c6b22347c0b0040d6aec4f444e83f0e67975a61defb16`.
It tests provider taxonomy placeholders and source preservation. It is not a
complete scientific sample bundle or ground truth for species identification.
See the [reference contract](../../../docs/ANEMONE_TAXONOMY_REFERENCE.md) for
scope, expected results, and the existing-data rebuild procedure.
